# New Lobby Design!!
After adding voice chat to Goob, I realized we had quite a few popups that would all stack on top of each other. So of course I went straight into building a news system to replace them.
Instantly, I ran into a problem, the old lobby was so fucking cluttered that I couldn't reasonably fit it in anywhere.
So I started cleaning up the lobby, and before I knew it I'd redesigned the entire thing. Halfway through, I started styling it like hull plating, cuz it's cool.
Then I figured the character customization screen should probably match the lobby, and went...
[bold]man.[/bold] [italic]this shit sucks too.[/italic]
Picking markings and hair from a dropdown is so fucking bad. You have no clue what anything looks like until you click it, and slowly going through the list to find the one you want is [bold]ASS[/bold].
Fuck it, we making a new character customization screen too.
## What's new
### Lobby - A news feed with pinned posts (ur reading it right now) - Chat and News tabs - Round info and ready status moved into the bottom side panel and made [italic]fancy[/italic] - Links and the menu moved into dropdowns instead of a wall of buttons at the top
### Character customization - Hair, markings, and species all now have preview tiles instead of dropdowns. - Skin and eye color swatches, and an age slider - Ability to hide jobs you can't play yet - A trait points bar
Here's what the new bits look like, (you can press them :-] ).
The sprites are by our glorious leader, [bold]@Rouge2t7[/bold] on Discord.
It's not quite finished yet
(need to replace the JOIN and SAVE buttons and the NT metal panel, maybe change up the seven segement to be real pixel art, etc.)
but I wanted to get it out so you guys can start giving feedback on it. Hope you like it!
[italic]- Durk[/italic]
